answer: Prayers & Duties >> Taharah (Purity) Question ID: 4156 Country: SL Title: Will Chewing gum spoil my wudw? Question: Will Chewing gum spoil my wudw? Answer ID: 4156 Posted on: Sep 1, 2020 Bismillah hir-Rahman nir-Rahim ! (Fatwa: 255/255=M) The wuzu will not be nullified by consuming chewing gum. Allah (Subhana Wa Ta'ala) knows Best Darul Ifta, Darul Uloom Deoband, India
